meta.title: autoPAN clear momentum
meta.subtitle: Warm, useful kiosk campaign mood board
meta.summary: A visual direction for a youth-center self-check-in kiosk: clear momentum, warm service, and light trails as the sign of a fast confident flow.

brief.theme: autoPAN tablet kiosk for youth-center reception
brief.goal: Make the kiosk feel easy, quick, trustworthy, and staff-friendly for on-site registration.
brief.audience: Youth-center visitors, guardians, and front-desk staff who need a clear reception flow.
brand_inputs: Existing product context: Korean tablet kiosk for Nowon Youth Center third-floor reception.
Operational tone: sparse copy, search-first member flow, fixed action areas, no marketing clutter.
brief.palette_direction: warm whites, soft amber light, clear sky blue, gentle graphite, small green confirmation accents
visual_principles: warm practical service instead of abstract futurism
motion cues should clarify the next step
interfaces should be implied without readable text or real private data

constraints: one single visual reference image per tile

items.title: Arrival light path
items.caption: A warm hallway arrival cue where a soft trail of light leads naturally toward a reception tablet.
items.palette: warm white, amber, clean blue, pale wood
items.prompt: Single editorial photograph of a youth-center reception hallway with a tablet kiosk ahead on a simple counter, a soft amber light trail flowing along the floor toward the tablet, warm practical lighting, clear sense of arrival and forward motion, no readable text, no logos, no private details, no UI labels.

style.label: More documentary
style.description: Make the arrival feel more real and less staged.
style.promptHint: Shift to documentary youth-center realism with natural light, preserving the light path and kiosk arrival cue.

style.label: Cleaner campaign
style.description: Tighten the image into a more polished campaign key visual.
style.promptHint: Use a cleaner editorial campaign treatment with stronger negative space and a clearer tablet destination.

palette.label: Warmer amber
palette.promptHint: Lean into amber practical lighting and warm whites while keeping the blue only as a small clarity accent.

scene.label: Closer entrance
scene.description: Move the viewer closer to the moment of entering.
scene.promptHint: Frame from just inside the doorway, with the light trail drawing the eye toward the kiosk.

props.label: Reception counter
props.promptHint: Emphasize pale wood, clean counter edge, and a practical tablet stand.

character.label: Subtle visitor
character.description: Add human scale without making people the subject.
character.promptHint: Include a softly blurred visitor silhouette approaching the kiosk, with no identifiable face.

format.label: Poster crop
format.description: Leave space for later campaign copy.
format.promptHint: Compose as a vertical poster-ready image with clean upper negative space.

items.title: Tablet touch momentum
items.caption: A close practical touch moment, with light trails showing the action moving from choice to completion.
items.palette: warm white, clear blue, graphite, soft amber
items.prompt: Single close-up editorial photograph of a hand tapping a tablet kiosk on a clean counter, the screen glow abstract and unreadable, a subtle blue and amber light trail arcs from the fingertip to the tablet edge, practical warm service setting, no readable text, no logos, no identifiable private data, no UI labels.

style.label: More tactile
style.description: Bring out hand, glass, and counter texture.
style.promptHint: Make it a tactile close-up with crisp glass reflections and soft skin/counter detail.

palette.label: Blue clarity
palette.description: Make the motion cue feel more precise.
palette.promptHint: Use a clear blue trail against warm whites, avoiding cold corporate tech.

scene.label: Desk angle
scene.description: Show more of the reception desk environment.
scene.promptHint: Pull back slightly to reveal the counter, tablet stand, and warm service context.

props.label: Tablet stand
props.description: Make the kiosk hardware feel stable.
props.promptHint: Feature a sturdy tablet stand and clean counter edge without any brand mark.

character.label: Youth hand
character.promptHint: Use a youthful hand gesture, cropped so no face or personal detail appears.

format.label: Wide hero
format.description: Make it usable as a site hero.
format.promptHint: Compose a wide horizontal campaign frame with open space on one side.

items.title: Member search glow
items.caption: The existing-member lookup becomes a clean search moment, visually fast without showing real data.
items.palette: soft white, blue glow, amber edge, graphite
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a tablet kiosk angled on a youth-center desk, abstract unreadable search interface glow on the screen, a fine blue light trail forming a gentle path across the glass, warm staff area in background, no readable text, no names, no phone numbers, no logos, no UI labels.

style.label: More minimal
style.description: Reduce background detail for stricter clarity.
style.promptHint: Create a minimal clean composition with the search glow and tablet as the main proof object.

palette.label: Softer contrast
palette.description: Make the flow feel less clinical.
palette.promptHint: Use softer graphite and warm whites with only a small blue search cue.

scene.label: Counter service
scene.description: Tie lookup to the front desk.
scene.promptHint: Show the tablet on a reception counter with a softly blurred staff presence.

props.label: Simple stand
props.promptHint: Use a simple tablet stand and practical counter materials.

character.label: Staff nearby
character.description: Add reassurance without making staff central.
character.promptHint: Include a blurred staff figure in the background as a warm support cue.

format.label: Square social
format.description: Center the tablet for social announcement use.
format.promptHint: Compose as a square image with the tablet centered and light trail clearly visible.

items.title: Counter service flow
items.caption: Warm staff support and self-service sit together, with light trails guiding the next step.
items.source: repo context: kiosk plus desk guidance
items.palette: amber, warm white, clear blue, pale wood
items.prompt: Single editorial photograph of a friendly youth-center reception counter with a tablet kiosk in the foreground and a softly blurred staff member gesturing toward it, a gentle light trail connects the staff gesture to the tablet, warm useful atmosphere, no readable text, no logos, no identifiable faces, no UI labels.

style.label: Human warmer
style.description: Make the service relationship feel more human.
style.promptHint: Emphasize a warm staff gesture and approachable service posture while preserving anonymity.

palette.label: Pale wood
palette.description: Make materials feel softer and less corporate.
palette.promptHint: Use pale wood, warm white walls, and small blue motion accents.

scene.label: Side view
scene.description: Show the service sequence across the counter.
scene.promptHint: Frame from the side so the gesture, tablet, and counter form a left-to-right flow.

props.label: Desk details
props.description: Add practical but uncluttered desk cues.
props.promptHint: Add clean desk details like a card tray or cable-free tablet stand, no documents with text.

character.label: Blurred staff
character.promptHint: Use a softly blurred staff figure with a helpful gesture, no identifiable facial features.

format.label: Presentation crop
format.description: Make it work in a service explainer slide.
format.promptHint: Compose in a 16:9 horizontal slide crop with open space for later deterministic copy.

items.title: Choice cards motion
items.caption: The game/space choices feel simple and fast, represented as abstract physical cards and motion light.
items.source: repo context: PC, Nintendo, PlayStation, space use choices
items.motif: abstract option cards with light trail
items.palette: warm white, sky blue, amber, soft green
items.prompt: Single composed studio photograph of four unlabeled abstract option cards on a warm desk beside a tablet kiosk, subtle light trails moving between the cards and the tablet, playful but clean youth-center service energy, no readable text, no icons that copy real brands, no logos, no UI labels, no collage.

style.label: More playful
style.promptHint: Use slightly brighter card colors and gentle motion trails while keeping the scene organized.

palette.label: Green confirm
palette.promptHint: Use a small confirmation green accent among warm white, amber, and blue.

scene.label: Top-down
scene.promptHint: Use a top-down desk composition with the tablet and cards in a simple flow.

props.label: Game hints
props.promptHint: Include abstract controller-like shapes or simple device silhouettes without any real brand design.

character.label: No people
character.description: Keep it as a pure system detail.
character.promptHint: Keep the frame object-only, focused on choice cards and motion.

format.label: Clean square
format.description: Make it easy to compare on the board.
format.promptHint: Compose a clean square studio frame with stable margins.

items.title: Payment next step
items.caption: Paid use is shown as a clear transition from tablet to desk, without depicting real payment data.
items.source: repo context: paid usage handled at desk
items.palette: warm white, amber, blue, brushed metal
items.prompt: Single editorial photograph of a tablet kiosk on a reception counter with a small neutral payment tray nearby, an amber-blue light trail moves from the tablet toward the desk edge, warm useful service atmosphere, no readable text, no logos, no credit card numbers, no UI labels, no private data.

style.label: More premium
style.description: Make the paid step feel more orderly.
style.promptHint: Use polished counter materials and calm lighting while keeping the service step practical.

palette.label: Amber desk
palette.promptHint: Increase amber desk lighting and reduce blue to a narrow clarity trail.

scene.label: Desk edge
scene.description: Show where the next step happens.
scene.promptHint: Frame the tablet and payment tray near the counter edge with motion leading outward.

props.label: Neutral tray
props.promptHint: Use a small neutral tray or card reader silhouette without numbers or brand marks.

character.label: Hands only
character.promptHint: Include cropped hands near the counter, no faces or identifying details.

format.label: Ad crop
format.description: Leave room for later headline copy.
format.promptHint: Compose with open negative space on the upper right for deterministic ad copy later.

items.caption: A small green confirmation moment closes the flow and keeps the feeling light.

items.motif: confirmation glow and light trail end
items.palette: warm white, confirmation green, soft amber, graphite
items.prompt: Single close-up photograph of a tablet kiosk on a tidy youth-center counter, abstract unreadable confirmation glow on the screen, a soft light trail ending in a small green glow near the tablet, warm reassuring atmosphere, no readable text, no logos, no UI labels, no private information.

style.label: Softer finish
style.description: Make completion feel calmer and more human.
style.promptHint: Use softer focus and a gentle green confirmation glow, preserving the tablet completion cue.

palette.label: Green accent
palette.description: Make success clearer without becoming medical.
palette.promptHint: Use a small fresh green glow with warm whites and amber background light.

scene.label: Waiting area
scene.description: Connect completion to the next physical moment.
scene.promptHint: Show the kiosk with a softly blurred waiting or activity area behind it.

props.label: Clean counter
props.promptHint: Use a clean counter surface with only the tablet stand and subtle cable management.

character.label: Visitor leaving
character.promptHint: Include a blurred visitor moving away from the kiosk after completing reception.

format.label: Hero detail
format.description: Make it strong as a campaign detail shot.
format.promptHint: Crop tightly enough to feel like a hero detail but leave the confirmation glow visible.

style.label: More caring

palette.label: Soft family

scene.label: Closer hands

format.label: Social crop
